definitions.gloss: the following; the next (day, morning, year, etc.)
definitions.explanation: A prenominal word meaning 'the next' that attaches directly to a time noun. It cannot stand alone or take particles.

examples.english: The next day, he set off on a journey.

examples.japanese: {明|あ}くる⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}した→出発する：01832_shuppatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: We left early the next morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明|あ}くる{年|とし}、⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The year after the accident, a new hospital was built in the town.

notes:
A prenominal word ({連体詞|れんたいし}) meaning 'the next' or 'the following.' It attaches directly to a time noun and cannot stand alone or take particles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {明|あ}くる{日|ひ}: the next day
- {明|あ}くる⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧: the next morning
- {明|あ}くる{年|とし}: the following year

USAGE:
Somewhat literary; in everyday speech ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ or ⟦{翌日|よくじつ}→翌日：17960_yokujitsu⟧ are more common.
